mapper.select: SELECT PR.ROUTE_ID , PRS.ROUTE_SEGMENT_ID , PRS.SEGMENT_ORDER , PRS.SEGMENT_TYPE , PRS.TIME_MINUTES AS SEGMENT_TIME_MINUTES , PRS.GUIDANCE , PRS.VEHICLES , PRP.LAT , PRP.LNG FROM PARTICIPANT_ROUTE PR JOIN PARTICIPANT_ROUTE_SEGMENT PRS ON PRS.ROUTE_ID = PR.ROUTE_ID JOIN PARTICIPANT_ROUTE_POINT PRP ON PRP.ROUTE_SEGMENT_ID = PRS.ROUTE_SEGMENT_ID WHERE PR.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} ORDER BY PR.ROUTE_ID , PRS.SEGMENT_ORDER , PRP.POINT_ORDER
